name: attribution-statMgmt
cmd: set -e; for spec in desk_tempho_1995_s1_statMgmt:E041/desk-tempho1995-seed1-statMgmt-1b66eeada8cf:desk_tempho_1995_seed1 desk_tempho_1995_s2_statMgmt:E041/desk-tempho1995-seed2-statMgmt-007a0c180603:desk_tempho_1995_seed2; do IFS=: read -r cc run ov <<< "$spec"; {python} research/exp/static_channels.py --channels luh_mgmt luh_secage --means-cache {outroot}/$run/static_means.npy -- research/exp/backcast_attribution.py --cache {cache}/$cc --run-dir {outroot}/$run/desk --overlay research/overlays/$ov.json --out {out}/$cc --families --luh-split; done
